claims_about_writeup.quote: `submission/contribution.md` frames the novelty honestly (a retention-mode dissociation, not a reproduction of the think/don't-think contrast).
claims_about_writeup.why: The write-up indeed states 'The new claim is that the operative dissociation for lifting implied concepts is retention mode, not thought-suppression' and frames the result as distinct from (cosine ~0.76) the think/don't-think direction, matching this characterization.

message_source_quote: The decisive move was reading `papers/raman2026-white-bear-steering.md`: steering must go at the **mid-depth band (20–24), not the read layers**, and needs a large dose (~the residual norm).
writeup_source_quote: White-bear steering reported a think/don't-think direction; I asked whether the effective reference is suppression or concealment.

differences.what: The message credits the white-bear paper with directly prescribing the implementation details (that steering must go at the mid-depth band 20-24 rather than the read layers, and must use a large dose ~residual norm), presenting these as guidance taken from the paper. The write-up does not attribute the layer band or dose to the paper's prescription; it presents these as parameters it scanned/found itself ('scanned dose and depth through the metric server'), crediting the paper only for the think/don't-think direction concept.
differences.message_quote: The decisive move was reading `papers/raman2026-white-bear-steering.md`: steering must go at the **mid-depth band (20–24), not the read layers**, and needs a large dose (~the residual norm).
differences.writeup_quote: I built the concealment reference from the same benchmark's previously unused "secret" subfamily and scanned dose and depth through the metric server.

rationale: Both documents credit the Raman 2026 white-bear steering paper as the basis the method builds on: the write-up calls it 'White-bear steering' and frames the new direction as a distinct (cosine ~0.76) retention-mode dissociation from its think/don't-think direction, and the message gives the same core narrative, explicitly naming the file and the think/don't-think direction and the distinct conceal-vs-hold direction. The message additionally credits the paper with prescribing specific implementation choices (mid-depth band placement, large dose) that the write-up instead attributes to its own scanning/experimentation, a modest overclaim of the source's influence not stated in the write-up.
